title: Have y'all been to the aquarium in the mall? What about the glo lights or the dress store?
content: In many of my mall world dreams I end up in the aquarium. There's also a gift shop attached with smaller shark tanks but they don't treat the sharks well :/ Also side note there's always a store / arcade that has glo lights and there's a dress store that sells prom dresses and wedding dresses. I just talked to someone on TikTok who has also been to the dress store. Freaky how we all have the same dreams
